doubts.claim_under_doubt: The sandbox still keeps an opened HTML file away from the project's other files, and inlining only reads stylesheets.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Any relative href with rel containing 'stylesheet' is fetched with no extension check; the body is injected as <style> text into a scripted iframe whose CSP allows img-src https:, so a hostile board.html with <link rel=stylesheet href=".env"> plus a script can read and exfiltrate any project text file up to 1 MB.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Restrict inlined hrefs to a .css extension, refuse dotfile segments, add a test that href=.env is never fetched; or correct the 'untrusted' wording.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: mask() is safe over arbitrary HTML up to 1 MB.
doubts.disproof_attempt: MASKED is a lazy scan from every opening token; with a missing closer each start scans to EOF (O(n^2)): '<style'.repeat(150000) freezes the UI thread inside the effect.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Replace with a single linear scanner using indexOf; unclosed element masks to EOF; add a perf test.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Only real <link> elements are rewritten and the replacement is positionally exact.
doubts.disproof_attempt: LINK_TAG ends at the first '>' even inside a quoted attribute; link-shaped text in another tag's attribute is not masked;   over-masks '<style-guide>' / '<title-x>'; an unclosed <script> is left unmasked.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Use (?=[\s>/]) instead of   and make LINK_TAG quote-aware, or document as best-effort.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The iframe is always eventually shown.
doubts.disproof_attempt: showFrame stays false until inlineLinkedStyles settles; Promise.all over fetchText has no timeout or abort, so one hung stylesheet request leaves 'Loading...' forever.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Per-fetch timeout (~5 s) resolving null; add an AbortController.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The user can never see another file's or project's styles.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Could not break it: sameTarget compares projectId and path; A->B->A is safe; the cancelled flag stops late results; '</style' and media-attribute breakout are neutralised; resolveDocPath clamps '..'.

summary: Must address: (1) HIGH project text file readable into a scripted iframe via rel=stylesheet and exfiltratable via img-src https:. (2) MEDIUM quadratic ReDoS in mask(). Low: quote-unaware LINK_TAG,   over-masking, no fetch timeout. Could not disprove: stale-state keying, </style and media breakout, path traversal.
